title: (Pwn2Own) Ubiquiti Networks AI Bullet Improper Certificate Validation Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected Ubiquiti Networks AI Bullet cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ubnt_avclient component. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the certificate presented by a server. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
